subject.title: Runtime-level model fallback on API call failure

question: Should an explicit session model selection remain strict, or may eligible runtime failures temporarily use the configured fallback chain—and should that ever clear the persisted user selection?
rationale: Current code and documentation intentionally preserve explicit user choice; changing it can alter provider, credential, cost, privacy, and tool-policy behavior, so the permanent semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Temporary fallback
options.body: Allow classified transient failures to use the existing fallback chain for the current run while retaining the user's session selection for later turns.

options.title: Strict selection
options.body: Keep explicit session choices fail-closed and improve the error with a visible in-product action to reset or choose another model.

options.title: Clear failed selection
options.body: Automatically remove the persisted user override and continue future turns from the configured primary or fallback state.

recommendation.title: Temporary fallback
recommendation.body: Allow classified transient failures to use the existing fallback chain for the current run while retaining the user's session selection for later turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work under this owner established the distinction between user-selected and automatic fallback session state.
